answer: When the tide of new signups tops the 200 seats each epoch reserves, admission flips to a sealed-bid auction: every newcomer must outbid that epoch's clearing price, roughly 8,000 POA, and the winning bid stays locked for sixty epochs. Cluster analysis exposing a nebula of clones under one operator burns every linked bid, so a hundred fakes forfeit 800,000 POA, and their forfeited stakes drain into the nectar pool honest identities harvest.
